The subagent reported back: its own subagent fetched https://example.com and returned the page title **Example Domain**. It noted that WebFetch was a deferred tool, so the schema was loaded first via `ToolSearch` with `select:WebFetch` before the fetch.

It also mentioned in passing that several MCP servers (Gmail, Google Calendar, LawCyborg, Linear, Notion, figma) need OAuth authorization and are unavailable in this non-interactive session — that didn't affect this task.

a1.1.summary:
The subagent reported the page title of https://example.com as **Example Domain**. It confirmed WebFetch was a deferred tool and loaded its schema via ToolSearch (`select:WebFetch`) before making the fetch.

Note: several MCP servers (claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar, LawCyborg, Linear, Notion, and the figma plugin) require OAuth authorization, which can't be completed in this non-interactive session. Those tools are unavailable until authorized via claude.ai connector settings or `/mcp` in an interactive session — none of that blocked this task.
